items.name: Chappal
items.desc: +3 ATK. Ranged. Never misses, even in smog. +30% damage against uncles.
items.breakText: Your *Chappal* has been confiscated by Mummy. She needs it for something.

items.name: Cork Ball
items.desc: +6 ATK. Ranged. Opening shot is a Yorker: 150% damage, 25% chance to stun.
items.breakText: Your last *Cork Ball* goes over the neighbour's wall. One tip, one hand: you're out.

items.name: Badminton Racket
items.desc: +4 ATK. Close. Hits twice per turn at 60% damage each.
items.breakText: The *Badminton Racket*'s strings snap. The society uncles blame the wind.

items.name: Cricket Bat
items.desc: +8 ATK. Close. 20% chance of a Cover Drive for 200% damage.
items.breakText: Your *Cricket Bat*'s lease has ended. The neighbour wants it back.

items.name: Hockey Stick
items.breakText: Your *Hockey Stick* cracks. Once the national sport. Now firewood.

items.name: Steel Tiffin
items.breakText: Your *Steel Tiffin* has a fist-shaped dent. Mummy wants it back anyway.

items.name: FASTag
items.desc: Skip the Toll Tax debuff at the next border.

items.name: Health Insurance
items.desc: If Bablu dies, AIIMS revives him once at 50% HP. The policy expires in 3 days.

items.name: Laathi
items.desc: +12 ATK. Close. 25% chance: Lathicharge hits every enemy.
items.breakText: Your *Laathi* is requisitioned by the local thana. They promise to return it. Temporarily.

items.name: Bubble Wrap
items.desc: The box was empty. The bubble wrap is very satisfying, though.
